attendance.note: Organiser-reported on Instagram: 'Ya van 20 y 18.000 almas' over the 20th edition weekend. Organiser and Cabildo report about 7,000 on the first night; Macaronesia Fuerteventura reports about 11,000 on the second night.

add_sources.note: 5 Jul 2026 organiser post: 18,000 people over the weekend.
Organiser: 'La 1.° noche del #fem2026 contó con 7.000 personas'.
Cabildo press (Google snippet): about 7,000 on the Friday.
Google snippet: about 11,000 on the second and final night.

Cabildo article cites 'la colaboración entre ambas administraciones' (Cabildo de Fuerteventura and Ayuntamiento de La Oliva) to make the edition possible; Cotillo Joven runs the FEM de Día programme of workshops and street performances.
@culturafuerteventura, @cabildoftv and @aytolaoliva co-author most festival posts; Cabildo transport department funded festival shuttle buses (https://www.instagram.com/p/DaLNBMeqc_C/).
FEM de Día daytime workshops and street performances in El Cotillo.

add_gaps: No commercial sponsors identified; funding appears to be public (Cabildo de Fuerteventura and Ayuntamiento de La Oliva)
Audience age and gender not published
notes: 18,000 is now organiser-reported and matches day figures (7,000 plus about 11,000). Free beach festival run with island and municipal government backing; no brand partners visible, which may mean an open field for a first sponsor. Organiser entity still not named in sources.
